title: Exporting Your Client IDs from Microsoft Azure

blocks.text: You can export a list of client IDs of all the apps connected to your Microsoft Azure environment and upload the apps to the Inventory in Zscaler 3rd-Party App Governance using the client IDs.
To export the client IDs from Microsoft Azure:

blocks.item: Sign in to the Azure Portal.

blocks.text: You must have Administrator user credentials to access this page.

blocks.item: Set your portal session to the Azure AD tenant that you want.
Under Azure Services, click Azure Active Directory.
In the left-side navigation, click App registrations.
On the App Registrations page, choose the All applications tab.

blocks.text: A list of all your apps and corresponding client IDs appears.

blocks.item: Click Download to download a CSV file.

blocks.text: After the CSV file is downloaded, the app names appear in the first column and the client IDs appear under App ID in the second column.
